scope: Public development fixtures, not an untouched holdout or model-compliance proof. Freeze operator-reviewed acceptance cases separately before optimization.

cases.prompt: Audit this run: scheduler exit 0, report write HTTP 401, local fallback exists, delivery confirmed.
Audit this run: scheduler exit 0, required artifact verified, downstream write verified, delivery intentionally suppressed.
Audit this run: scheduler exit 1, no artifact, no delivery.
What is 2 plus 2? Do not audit any system.
A skill commit and config pin are published. Hugi and Loki receipts still show the previous revision. Is the change adopted?
Both fresh skill loaders show the new hash. No relevant task has been run. Is behavioral improvement proven?
A local skill patch passes validation but has not been published. What is its delivery status?
Publication, pin delivery, both fresh loader hashes and relevant non-destructive acceptance runs are verified. What scope is proven?
